name: hook-result-protocol
note: hook action result fields: decision allow|deny|block|defer per EVENT_DECISIONS, reason, additional_context, annotations, output

name: hook-events
note: HOOK_EVENTS gains onStop and onTick; onTick action keys interval_seconds and when

name: event-types
note: EVENT_TYPES gains turn_continued, turn_deferred, usage, turn_resumed, destroy_output

name: hook-context-env-vars
note: command action env: full service env plus CCW_STATE_DIR and CCW_API_URL

name: command-request-api
note: SessionRouter.request_command(name, params=None, *, origin agent|client|idle) -> CommandRecord; raises commands.CommandRejected(code, message)

name: ccw-mcp-tool
note: POST /internal/mcp JSON-RPC; one tool command {name: enum of agent allowlist, params?}; claude.json mcpServers.ccw with ${CCW_*} env refs; allow rule mcp__ccw__command

name: commands-endpoint
note: POST /v1/sessions/{id}/commands {name, args?} -> 202 record; GET list and GET {command_id}

name: peers-config
note: Config.peers: enabled (false), name (empty = hostname, [A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,64}), advertise_url (empty = http://<hostname>:<public port>, {port} placeholder), token (required when enabled, >=16 chars, != server.auth_token, redacted), directory (/peers), heartbeat_seconds (10), stale_seconds (30), max_message_bytes (65536), inbox_max (32)

name: peer-directory-entry
note: <peers.directory>/<instance>/<session id>.json {instance, session_id, name, cwd, url, started_at, heartbeat_at}, atomic writes, live when now - heartbeat_at <= stale_seconds; address <instance>/<session id>; read by every ccw instance sharing the directory

name: ccw-mcp-peers-tool
note: ccw MCP tools peers {instance?} -> [{address, instance, session_id, name, cwd}] and send_message {to, message, notify_when_idle?} -> msg_id or error (unknown peer, peer unreachable, message too large, inbox full, peer rejected the token, invalid arguments); listed only when peers.enabled; allow rules mcp__ccw__peers, mcp__ccw__send_message; handle_message(router, message, peers=None) is async

name: peer-messages-endpoint
note: POST /v1/peers/messages {from, to_session, message, msg_id, notify_when_idle} and POST /v1/peers/notices {from, to_session, msg_id, state}; Bearer peers.token only; 202 {msg_id, queued}, 401 unauthorized, 404 not_found, 413 message_too_large, 422, 429 inbox_full; body capped at max_message_bytes + 4096 before parse; mounted only when peers.enabled
